text.p: Rogert Tetrault, chief executive officer of McDermott International Inc and its majority-owned subsidiary J. Ray McDermott S.A., has been elected chairman of both companies, the companies said Monday.
Tetrault, who will continue as CEO and as vice chairman of both companies, will succeed James Dutt, who will retire as chairman and a director on June 1, they said.
Tetrault joined the global energy services companies on March 1 as vice chairman and CEO.

Dutt, 72, has been a director of McDermott International since February 1982 and was chairman and CEO of both companies from September 1996 and until March 1, when Tetrault assumed the duties of CEO and Dutt continued as chairman.
Dutt is also chairman of the board of Stratxx Ltd, a management consulting firm he has headed since 1986.
